review.summary: Native ivory/gold tile shading retained; one verified slide, two three-tile clears and exact surviving identities checked in encoded samples.

Seventeen animated tiles become eleven survivors, with three unrelated locks retained and no refill or win.

review.native_style: Tile crops preserve their ivory shading, golden undersides and simplified printed symbols; no flat restyle or scene-wide lighting effect.
limitations: Deterministic two-dimensional still-image motion mockup, not engine gameplay or a newly implemented game.
